t.l: --- SAVES AND WARPS ---
SAVE: /save or /sw
LOAD: /warp or /lw
DELETE: /delwarp or /dw
--- FIXED TRAINING SLOTS (must be logged in) ---
/sw 1 to /sw 5 -> saves position, rotation, speed and vehicle in that slot.
/lw 1 to /lw 5 -> returns to the slot. They are stored in your account, even if the server restarts. /sw and /lw without a number work as before.
PRIVATE: /privado
VEHICLES: /cv, /del, /gm
In Play Mode (dimension 0) /sw only saves with the vehicle STOPPED (up to 5 km/h) and touching the ground. Staff (Admin / SuperModerator / Moderator) can save freely.
--- SPECTATOR MODE (/watch) ---
/watch [id or part of the name] -> spectates the player (camera follows them). Also from the SPECTATE (WATCH) button in F7, with the player selected in the list.
Backspace or /watch (with nothing) -> leaves and puts you back exactly where you were, in the same vehicle. While spectating you are parked (frozen, invisible and without collision).
/copiarsave -> while spectating, copies the save of the player you are watching (or /copiarsave [id or name] at any time).
Respects the player's MY WARP: LOCKED. In Play Mode you must be stopped (up to 3 km/h) and on the ground to start spectating (staff has no such limits).
--- SPEEDOMETER HUD (/stanthud) ---

Optional speedometer in the bottom-right corner: KM/H, MPH, gear/RPM and nitro charge. Starts OFF; toggle it with /stanthud or in SETTINGS > SPEEDOMETER HUD (your choice is saved). When on, it hides GTA's native HUD elements so they don't overlap.
--- WEATHER / TIME (your game only) ---
/timeset [hour] -> sets the hour (0-23). Minutes allowed: /timeset 17:30
/w [id] -> changes the weather (0-255). E.g. /w 1
The clock is FROZEN (default 12:00): sky and shadows don't change between attempts, ideal for recording clips. The chosen time/weather does not affect other players.
--- TRAINING / RECORDING VISUALS (your game only) ---

[I] Invisible Objects -> toggle: shows the map's invisible ramps, walls and platforms as semi-transparent. When off, they go invisible again. If nothing shows up, use /objdebug near the object to see how the map hides it.
[O] Hide Players -> other players and their vehicles DISAPPEAR from your screen (no engine sound, smoke, lights, nitro, shadow or name tag), ideal for recording clean clips.
[K] Transparent Players -> other players and vehicles become semi-transparent GHOSTS (without seeing the car interior through the body), ideal for training in groups without blocking the track.

O and K replace each other: turning one on turns the other off. Pressing the same key again brings everyone back to normal. You and your vehicle are never affected. Keys can be changed in SETTINGS and don't work with the chat or cursor open.
--- SEGMENTED REPLAY ---

[F10] Record Replay -> while driving a vehicle, starts recording your inputs. Each SAVE (/sw) becomes a checkpoint; each WARP (/lw) erases the failed attempt and rewinds the recording to the save, seamlessly: in the end only the clean run is left.
Press F10 again to finish: give it a name and choose SAVE LOCAL (.CSV), SAVE AND PUBLISH TO GALLERY (all staff can see it) or DISCARD.
--- GALLERY AND PLAYER (/replays, the REPLAYS button or the F4 key) ---

[F4] Open Replay Gallery -> opens/closes the gallery directly, without going through F7 (closes the F7 menu if it is open). The key can be changed in SETTINGS > Open Replay Gallery and does not work while the chat, the console or a text field is active.
Filter by My Replays (local) or Public Gallery, search by name/creator/vehicle and use WATCH (or double-click), PUBLISH or DELETE.
In the player: Space = play/pause, Arrows = -3s/+3s, click the bar to jump, 0.1x to 4x buttons, LOOP, K = FOLLOW/FLYCAM camera, H = hide the interface, ESC or Backspace = exit.
FOLLOW: GTA's native camera following the replay car (doesn't clip through ramps). Hide the UI (H) to rotate with the mouse; V changes the distance.
FLYCAM: WASD moves, Q/E down/up, Shift fast, Ctrl slow, scroll changes the speed. With the interface hidden, the mouse turns the camera without holding a button.
The player applies the recording's time and weather and restores yours on exit.
--- GHOST MODE (race against a replay) ---
In the gallery, pick the Ghost Mode and click RACE AGAINST (GHOST): you keep driving while a translucent car repeats the run on the track.
Sync with Warp + Loop: the ghost restarts on every warp (/lw), so you start together.
Continuous Loop Only: the ghost runs non-stop, ignoring warps.
A-B section: mark A and B in the replay player (L key / A-B button), exit it and start the Ghost of that same replay: it loops only inside A-B, always restarting at A (and Sync starts at A).
3D Trail: the Ghost draws its exact path as a 3D line (toggle in the gallery or in F7 > Settings).
To stop: L key (configurable in SETTINGS > Stop Ghost), /stopghost or STOP GHOST in the gallery.

Resets everything to default (400 ms, speed ON, no cooldown, 20 saves...) and applies it at once.
0 to 1500 ms (default 400): time held still at the spot before the vehicle is released and the speed applied. 0 = released on the same frame.
0 to 10 s (default 0): minimum gap between two /lw from the same player. 0 = no limit.
1 to 50 (default 20): how many /sw each player keeps in their history (/dw steps back one by one).
ON: /lw gives back the saved linear and angular speed. OFF: position and rotation only, standing still.
